rationale: A real-data run must not promote itself to a scientific claim. This record is consumed by p22.eval.real_paired_acceptance and binds the declared representation, count unit, ordered identities, per-fold donor provenance and protocol settings for the N18/N19/N20 gene-activity panel entry point to the executable configuration. The panel identity (configs/nn_gene_activity_2026-09-23.bed, sha256 946fd00023079d5f39ac8cb14d77a74ac25ec1167a1b24adc45f40ffb3635282) and the count contract (configs/atac_measurement_contract_2026-09-21.json) were frozen before the quantification command was launched; only the JSON wrapping is written later.
declaration_timing: the panel BED and count contract were committed before the N20 quantify command; this requirements record was written after the quantification was launched but before any acceptance evaluation, and it declares only pre-fixed choices.
preserved_historical_result: docs/repeated_internal_comparison_2026-09-21.json is unchanged; this record does not revise it.

atac.interval_rule: a fragment record qualifies for region [beg, end) when fragment_start < end and fragment_end > beg; fragment_start >= fragment_end records are ignored

regions.rule: fixed label-free gene-activity panel: all chr21 genes with RNA detection in >=1% of cells, ranked by normalized dispersion until the transfer estimate reaches the 3.5e9 byte budget; gene body +/-2000bp clipped at 0, canonical chr1-22/X, zero-based half-open; the identical 548-window list is used in every fold so no donor's fragment data enters feature definition

population.retained_population: H5AD retained set; unknown barcodes are refused, never silently dropped

protocol.margin_rule: practical_margin(15, 15); not lowered after seeing results

manifest.note: generated after the gene-activity ATAC matrix is measured; until it exists no real run may set scientific_claim_allowed
